title: R/V Vema Voyage 24, 1967

legs.remarks: Typical Gulf of Mexico weather (sloppy) - berthed Cristobal (transit 21st).
Proceeded along Lats. 1-5 degs. to approx. 150W. All good weather.
Dateline crossing - #1 Aux. GM burned main bearings, etc. Fine weather.
Rendezvoused with Toshi Maru in Subic Bay - loaded powder. Carried out seismic program South China Sea. Weather terrible.
Wonderful weather - rendezvoused in Queen Carola Hbr, Bougainville for termination of program with Japanese "Toshi Maru".
Joint seismic refraction program with HMAS "Diamantina" - very successful.
Via Torres Strait, Dundas Strait & Clarence Strait. Torres Strait Pilot "Bowe" - Dundas & Clarence Strait Pilot "Kohler". 6 Kts circulating currents?
Fine weather - broke stub shaft of coring winch - whole new gear train installed by Ludas in Mauritius.
Mod. weather, head sea & swell for first 2 weeks. Last 5 days on reduced speed for sonobuoys.
Stop at Barbados for fuel - fuel consumption high due adverse weather - currents and very heavy marine growth on bottom.

events.title: Departed New York
events.text: Leg 1: New York to Miami. Chief scientist J.L. Worzel.

events.title: Arriving Miami
events.text: Moderate weather - successful shakedown.

events.title: Departed Miami
events.text: Leg 2: Miami to Cristobal. Chief scientist J.L. Worzel.

events.title: Arriving Cristobal
events.text: Typical Gulf of Mexico weather (sloppy) - berthed Cristobal (transit 21st).

events.title: Panama Canal
events.text: Transited the Panama Canal from Cristobal to Balboa (10 hours).

events.title: Departed Balboa
events.text: Leg 3: Balboa to Honolulu. Chief scientist J.L. Worzel.

events.title: Arriving Honolulu
events.text: Proceeded along Lats. 1-5 degs. to approx. 150W. All good weather.

events.title: Departed Honolulu
events.text: Leg 4: Honolulu to Midway. Chief scientist G.M. Bryan.

events.title: Crossed the International Date Line
events.text: Westbound: the calendar jumps a day ahead.

events.title: Crossed the International Date Line
events.text: Eastbound: the same date happens twice.

events.title: Arriving Midway
events.text: Fine weather.

events.title: Departed Midway
events.text: Leg 5: Midway to Manila. Chief scientist G.M. Bryan.

events.title: Crossed the International Date Line
events.text: Westbound: the calendar jumps a day ahead.

events.title: Arriving Manila
events.text: Dateline crossing - #1 Aux. GM burned main bearings, etc. Fine weather.

events.title: Departed Manila
events.text: Leg 6: Manila to Manila. Chief scientist W.J. Ludwig.

events.title: Subic Bay
events.text: Rendezvous with the Japanese ship Toshi Maru in Subic Bay; loaded explosives ("powder") for the seismic program.

events.title: Arriving Manila
events.text: Rendezvoused with Toshi Maru in Subic Bay - loaded powder. Carried out seismic program South China Sea. Weather terrible.

events.title: Departed Manila
events.text: Leg 7: Manila to Townsville. Chief scientist W.J. Ludwig.

events.title: Crossed the Equator
events.text: Into the Southern Hemisphere.

events.title: Queen Carola Harbour, Bougainville
events.text: Rendezvous in Queen Carola Harbour to end the joint seismic program with the Toshi Maru.

events.title: Deepest sounding of the voyage
events.text: 8,839 m (4,833 fathoms, 28,999 ft) of water under the keel.

events.title: Arriving Townsville
events.text: Wonderful weather - rendezvoused in Queen Carola Hbr, Bougainville for termination of program with Japanese "Toshi Maru".

events.title: Departed Townsville
events.text: Leg 8: Townsville to Townsville. Chief scientist R. Houtz.

events.title: Arriving Townsville
events.text: Joint seismic refraction program with HMAS "Diamantina" - very successful.

events.title: Departed Townsville
events.text: Leg 9: Townsville to Darwin. Chief scientist T.D. Aitken.

events.title: Torres Strait
events.text: Through Torres Strait with pilot "Bowe" aboard; then Dundas and Clarence Straits with pilot "Kohler".

events.title: Arriving Darwin
events.text: Via Torres Strait, Dundas Strait & Clarence Strait. Torres Strait Pilot "Bowe" - Dundas & Clarence Strait Pilot "Kohler". 6 Kts circulating currents?

events.title: Departed Darwin
events.text: Leg 10: Darwin to Mauritius. Chief scientist T.D. Aitken.

events.title: Arriving Mauritius
events.text: Fine weather - broke stub shaft of coring winch - whole new gear train installed by Ludas in Mauritius.

events.title: Departed Mauritius
events.text: Leg 11: Mauritius to Cape Town. Chief scientist T.D. Aitken.

events.title: Arriving Cape Town
events.text: Very poor weather - 2 heavy gales.

events.title: Departed Cape Town
events.text: Leg 12: Cape Town to Rio de Janeiro. Chief scientist T.D. Aitken.

events.title: Arriving Rio de Janeiro
events.text: Mod. weather, head sea & swell for first 2 weeks. Last 5 days on reduced speed for sonobuoys.

events.title: Departed Rio de Janeiro
events.text: Leg 13: Rio de Janeiro to Miami. Chief scientist R. (Sam) Gerard.

events.title: Crossed the Equator
events.text: Back into the Northern Hemisphere.

events.title: Barbados
events.text: Fuel stop at Barbados: fuel consumption was high from adverse weather, currents and very heavy marine growth on the hull.

events.title: Arriving Miami
events.text: Stop at Barbados for fuel - fuel consumption high due adverse weather - currents and very heavy marine growth on bottom.
